reviews.review:
Overall: 6.9/10 Good

TL;DR: Best in small bursts and/or with friends. The game has a fun vibe and play with comic relief and enough variety. In almost every respect the game offers some variety and just enough depth to keep it going, however being a continuous play type of game the variety can run its course in long playthroughs.

Gameplay: 1.3/2
A little above average, the game is centered around 4 classes and missions. The classes do have some form of variety within them in terms of loadout and the mission objectives require different approaches although still centered around a combination of combat and collecting. The mining and collecting has a slight amount of depth with carry amount and depositing but outside of that it is fairly simple. The combat feels good and there are weakspots and enemy armor which gives it something more than just point and shoot. It doesn't raise any bars but does feel fun.

Engagement: 1.0/2
In terms of story, progression, level variety and replay-ability, while not bad, is perhaps the weakest part of the game, leaving it somewhere in the middle of the road. The missions and levels have some form of variation but being a "never-ending" game you tend to repeat these quite often. There are plenty of cosmetic upgrades to get over time and just enough class/loadout upgrades as well. The game definitely shines best in multiplayer because of this but in terms of keeping single player from going stale it is best to play in "bursts".

Content: 1.4/10
The amount of content here is pretty good. There are quite a few cosmetics, jokes, and hidden details, mostly in the lobby area. The levels themselves do tend to feel a bit reskinned version of other levels but with some variety in hazards and random additional side challenges. None of these have large depth but enough variety is present to give more things to experience.

Art: 1.4/10
The art direction is a good, Nothing too stylistic but they did well with the style the did go with. Audio design is pretty good as well. The details and tone are well established as not taking itself too seriously with quite a bit of comic relief. The overall vibe the game seems to be going for is "fun".

Polish: 1.8/10
The game is polished very well. While there are glitches here and there, it is not that often and there are little to no bugs or performance issues.
